# Model Development

Research focused on developing new ESM models, improving architectures, and advancing protein language modeling.

Papers in this section describe the models themselves and methodological advances that enable better representations of protein biology.

---

## All Papers

| Title | Authors | Journal | Year | ESM Model(s) | Contributor | Summary |
|-------|---------|---------|------|-------------|-------------|---------|
| **Language Modeling Materializes a World Model of Protein Biology** | Candido et al. | BioRxiv | 2026 | ESM3, ESMC, ESMFold2 | Biohub | Introduces ESMC (trained on 2.8B metagenomic sequences) and ESMFold2 with state-of-the-art structure prediction. Demonstrates that language models learn a systematic organization of protein biology aligned with empirical science. Maps 6.8B proteins and 1.1B predicted structures. |

## Sort & Filter

To find papers by specific criteria:

- **By Model:** ESMC, ESM3, ESM2, ESMFold2
- **By Topic:** Scaling laws, architecture design, training methodology
- **By Lab Validation:** Experimentally validated designs
- **By Year:** 2025, 2026

See [Model Applications](model-applications.qmd) for papers using ESM models to solve biological problems.
